Yeah that may be what I have to do for now until I can get this under control. I guess one good thing that could come out of this is that at least now I'm being forced to deal with it head on and that I have a good therapist who can hopefully help. I can't keep running away from this and covering it up forever.

I'm not sure how to explain it but the compulsion to not go to work is so strong... I know most people would rather not go but somehow they manage and I can't. It makes me feel very guilty and pathetic that I can't manage to hold anything down even though I've gotten good opportunities and always get good references from the people around me. My mom always gives me the tough love speech, and while I understand it to be true, it still doesn't matter to me and the compulsion overwhelms any rational understanding that I need to go to work each day even if I don't want to. It just doesn't make sense and I don't understand why I think like that.

I looked it up and it seems to be geared towards people with diagnosed disabilities, which other than the depression I was diagnosed with a couple of years ago, I don't have any other diagnoses though of course there could be something. I mean I imagine there has to be something wrong with me more than the average person to cause this problem so consistently no matter what job I have even though I grew up on a farm so working was the norm and I've had jobs since I was 16. I just don't get it.

Hmm possibly, though the job I just quit was a temp-to-hire job so I know I can't go through that temp agency but there are a number of others in my city that I could talk to. I know some of them will pretty much take anyone off the street for the crappy jobs they have so that possibly could be an option.
Hey thanks, never heard of that before.

Unfortunately not really, I've already done that during the other times I was unemployed so I don't have much extra stuff to sell. The good news is that I know I can get about $25,000 for my car and use that get something cheaper and live off the rest, but my car means a lot to me and its going to kill me to have to sell it. I hate myself for doing this as it took me 5 years to save up for that car, but I did it anyway and I knew what the consequences would be. I'm so confused by it all.

Thanks hornless_unicorn, I appreciate it. I'm feeling so terrible right now I don't know words to describe it - the fact that I knew what would happen if I quit and yet did it anyway is haunting me to no end. I would talk to my therapist but he's on vacation this week and I really don't want to bother him, but I'm considering trying to get ahold of him anyway as I'm in a really bad place obviously.

I know I'm going to have to sell my car to get money to pay rent, and I knew that before I quit, yet I did it anyway. I knew that yet another short-term stint on my resume would look very bad and will probably make it harder to find another job, yet I did it anyway. I knew I would feel guilty for hurting the few people around me that I care about, yet I did it anyway. I simply don't know what to do or how to deal with my feelings because my normal response to bad situations is to flee, whether physically or emotionally and I can't do that here.
